cands.name: Veleria M. Levy
cands.bio: Nonprofit leader and health equity advocate. Former Executive Director of the North Carolina AIDS Action Network; President and CEO of HerHealth Consulting, LLC. Won the Democratic primary for NC House District 99 on March 3, 2026. No prior elected office is documented.

endorsements.text: Endorsements listed on her campaign site include Carolina Forward, Planned Parenthood, UNITE HERE Local 23, Sunrise Movement, Sierra Club, Lillian's List, Equality North Carolina, Progressive Caucus NCDP and Young Democrats of North Carolina.
Ballotpedia lists endorsements from Beyond The Ballot (Sway voting group) and the Progressive Caucus of the North Carolina Democratic Party.

cands.gaps: We could not find her birthplace, where she grew up, or when she came to North Carolina. We found no record of earlier elected office. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey. We found no statements from her on data centers, development and land, homestead property taxes, foreign or institutional land buyers, policing, gun policy or school choice. Only the title and a short excerpt of her blog posts were readable.

qual.background: Former Executive Director of the North Carolina AIDS Action Network; President and CEO of HerHealth Consulting, LLC (her own firm); campaign site cites more than two decades in public health and statewide policy advocacy in North and South Carolina.
qual.why: She has a long policy advocacy career and runs a business, which fits the middle band. No legislative or local elected office is documented, so she scores below the high band. Board service is not counted.

school-choice-teachers.evidence: Her campaign site says fully funded schools and competitive teacher pay help students succeed, and notes North Carolina ranks last in public school funding. It does not mention vouchers or charters.

pro-life.evidence: Her campaign site lists Planned Parenthood and Lillian's List among her endorsers, and lists women's health as a healthcare priority. It describes Planned Parenthood screening that detected her sister's cervical cancer early.

workers-first.evidence: She wrote a campaign blog post in January criticizing ICE and DHS enforcement, titled 'When Everyone Becomes a Target: ICE, DHS & Why This Moment Should Alarm Us All'. Only the title and an excerpt were visible.
